output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The vulnerability resides in the mintedAmount parameter, where it is added to the owner's balance without a check, allowing the owner to set the total supply arbitrarily high.
The transfer function allows the owner to transfer tokens to any address, including a compromised exchange, causing devaluation of the token.

The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The vulnerability resides in the amount parameter, where it is multiplied by sellPrice without a check, allowing attackers to overflow the amount variable and cause a crash in the exchange.

The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The vulnerability resides in the msg.value, where it is divided by buyPrice without a check, allowing attackers to overflow the msg.value variable and cause a crash in the exchange.
